name: myTeamGrievanceApplication
description: Lets a supervisor submit a grievance on behalf of one of their direct subordinates. Resolution order: team member (by name only - never ask for an employee number), template, ground, then summary/description (max 200 characters incl. spaces)/mood, then optional attachments. If no team member is given, or the named person is not a subordinate, the tool returns the team list to choose from; if several match (e.g. two Liams) it returns the matching names to pick from. Channel members for the template are returned in every response once known. Always previews first and only submits when called again with confirmed:true. Attachment size/type limits come from the module and are relayed if a file is rejected.
taskName: Submit a New Grievance for a subordinate
